name: musket-gamepad
description: D-198 / KydlCore D-176 (user 2026-11-28): the musket on a gamepad. The key hint has a gamepad side with every row (Fire, Both hands, Reload, Block) and no dead layout entries (the old NullReferenceException), the gamepad aim button raises the musket and the gamepad reload button reloads, through the same path as the real gamepad read (no controller in the lab). Not tested with a real controller.
